observation: Captured plain form in open-4 without --fauna-aggregate; fleetLook resolved siteId veil_ray_nursery (strainId charon_grave, driveState drift, draws 14, size 38.50 x 2.33 x 29.72 WU, rootName SF_VeilRay_Nursery_Adult). Both chase and close fit completely and show strong manta/kite membrane wings with scalloped trailing folds, tissue albedo/normal relief, 10 dark-red curved TubeGeometry fin ribs along raised folds, central keel spine, tapered tail, and restrained glow (emissiveIntensity 0.15). However, two concrete issues appear: (1) an open rectangular seam slot at the leading nose tip (ahead of the CapsuleGeometry keel between port and starboard wing roots) lets dark background show straight through in close and reads as a dark notch in chase; (2) 4 non-nursery ALIEN_SITES entries spawn veil_ray via buildVeilRay (faunaVisuals.js, stretched sphere/cylinder primitives), which was not exercised by default --fauna=veil_ray. Disturbed flap motion and ordinary play remain unverified.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — open nose-root seam gap ahead of keel on captured SF_VeilRay_Nursery_Adult, plus non-nursery open-water sites route to uncaptured primitive buildVeilRay.
next: Close the leading nose-root seam gap between wing membranes and keel on SF_VeilRay_Nursery_Adult, unify or rebuild non-nursery buildVeilRay so all sites use folded ribbed membrane geometry, and recapture both site paths.
